issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (shared across all SealSaloon instances), but in the solution implementation calculateTotalPrice is declared as an instance method. This discrepancy between the specification and the implementation can confuse students about whether the method should be static and how to call it (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) vs instance.calculateTotalPrice(...)).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the problem statement: declare calculateTotalPrice as static (e.g., public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and update any internal usage accordingly, or alternatively update the problem statement to remove the requirement that calculateTotalPrice be static so it matches the implementation. Prefer making the method static to follow the stated shared-stock design.
